composition:
  authorize: "hasRole('OWNER_ADMIN')"

# Idempotent create: read the optional 'Idempotency-Key' header before doing any work. If the key
# was already used to create an owner, throw IdempotentReplayException so the escalation handler
# replays the original owner with 200; otherwise publish the key for RecordIdempotencyKey to store
# once the insert succeeds. Runs first, so a repeat never re-validates or re-inserts.
checkIdempotency:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.CheckIdempotencyKey
  next: validate

# Validate required fields first so a missing/blank field is a 400 with an 'errors'
# array. This step binds the body once and republishes it for BuildOwner.
validate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.ValidateOwnerFields
  next: checkIdentityUnique

# The single duplicate check: reject (409) only when the new owner's WHOLE derived identityKey — the
# SHA-256 hex of normalizedTelephone|lowerEmail|soundex(lastName) — equals an existing owner's. This is
# now the only hard-duplicate check; the former separate household-duplicate block no longer applies.
# Because the telephone is part of the key, two members of the same household with different telephones
# have different identityKeys and are both allowed (the second flagged a soft match downstream). Reads
# within the same write transaction as the insert so the check and the insert see one consistent view.
checkIdentityUnique:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.CheckIdentityUnique
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: checkCityCapacity

# Reject (409) when the request's city already contains 50 or more owners. Reads within the same
# write transaction as the insert so the count and the insert see one consistent view.
checkCityCapacity:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.CheckCityCapacity
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: build

build:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.BuildOwner
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: defaultRegistrationDate

# Resolve the effective registrationDate (supplied, else today's server date) and roll a weekend
# date forward to the next Monday, so the persisted date is always a business day. Runs before the
# daily-limit count and save so both see the adjusted date.
defaultRegistrationDate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.DefaultRegistrationDate
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: checkDailyLimit

# Reject (429) once 100 or more owners have already been registered on this request's adjusted
# business day (by registrationDate). Runs after the date is resolved so it counts per business day,
# within the same write transaction as the insert so the count and the insert see one consistent view.
checkDailyLimit:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.CheckDailyLimit
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignMemberId

# Assign the '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>' memberId: REGION derived from the postcode (else city, else
# UNKNOWN), FY the two-digit fiscal year of the registrationDate, HASH8 the first 8 upper-case hex
# chars of SHA-256(normalizedTelephone + lastName) and CHK a single Luhn check digit over the digits
# of <REGION><FY><HASH8>. On a collision with an existing owner's memberId, append '-<n>' (smallest
# n >= 2) to keep it unique — reads existing owners within the write transaction so the check and the
# insert agree.
assignMemberId:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignMemberId
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignHouseholdId

# Assign the stable, shared householdId computed from the normalized last name + postcode, so owners
# with the same last name and postcode deterministically share one identifier. Runs before save so
# the id is persisted and returned.
assignHouseholdId:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignHouseholdId
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignHouseholdMemberCount

# Count this owner's household (owners sharing the assigned householdId) including this new owner,
# giving the household size after this create. Runs after the householdId is assigned and within the
# write transaction so it counts only owners already persisted plus this one.
assignHouseholdMemberCount:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignHouseholdMemberCount
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignNamesakeCount

# Count existing owners sharing this owner's firstName + lastName (case-insensitively). Runs before
# save within the write transaction so it counts only owners already persisted, excluding this new one.
assignNamesakeCount:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignNamesakeCount
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignBulkSignupWarning

# Flag (bulkSignupWarning) when more than 80 owners have already been registered on this request's
# adjusted business day. Runs after the date is resolved and within the same write transaction as the
# insert so the count reflects only owners already persisted (excluding this new one).
assignBulkSignupWarning:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignBulkSignupWarning
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignCapacityWarning

# Flag (capacityWarning) when the owner's city already holds 40-49 owners, so it is approaching the
# hard per-city capacity limit of 50 (which checkCityCapacity has already enforced upstream). Reads
# within the same write transaction as the insert so the count reflects only owners already persisted
# (excluding this new one), matching how checkCityCapacity counts a city.
assignCapacityWarning:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignCapacityWarning
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignPossibleDuplicate

# Flag a soft (non-hard) duplicate: the pipeline only reaches here once the hard-duplicate identity
# check has passed, so set possibleDuplicate true (with possibleDuplicateOf = matching owner id) when
# this owner shares an existing owner's lastName and postcode but has a different telephone, else false.
# Reads within the write transaction so it sees only owners already persisted (excluding this new one).
assignPossibleDuplicate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignPossibleDuplicate
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignMembershipLevel

# Assign the membershipLevel, applying the household level ceiling: the level derived from points,
# capped at one above the current maximum membershipLevel among existing household members (owners
# already persisted sharing this owner's householdId). With no existing household member the derived
# level stands uncapped. Runs after householdId, householdMemberCount and namesakeCount are assigned
# (the fields the derived level reads) and within the write transaction, so the household maximum sees
# only owners already persisted; the capped value is stored so reads return it.
assignMembershipLevel:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignMembershipLevel
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: save

save:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.SaveOwner
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: recordIdempotency

# Record the request's 'Idempotency-Key' (if any) against the now-persisted owner id, so a later
# repeat of the same key replays this owner with 200. Runs after save so the id exists.
recordIdempotency:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RecordIdempotencyKey
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: audit

# On successful create, emit the audit via the dedicated AUDIT logger: the human-readable line plus
# an immutable structured OWNER_CREATED event {seq, ownerId, memberId, membershipLevel} whose
# seq increases monotonically across creates. Runs after save so the generated id exists.
audit:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AuditOwnerCreated
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: notify

# On successful create, enqueue a welcome notification: emit a line via the dedicated NOTIFY logger
# carrying the owner's id and memberId. Runs after save so the generated id and memberId exist.
notify:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.EnqueueWelcomeNotification
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: respond

respond:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RespondWithOwnerCreated
  govern: [ transaction ]

I've read the full pipeline and verified each function class against the YAML. Here is the complete ordered list for `POST /api/owners`.

## Precondition (whole endpoint)

- **Authorization** — the endpoint file requires `hasRole('OWNER_ADMIN')`; without it the request never enters the pipeline.

## Ordered pipeline

Each step below runs in this exact order. I mark whether it can **reject** (validation) or **mutate/emit** (side-effect). Every step from `checkIdentityUnique` onward runs under one shared write transaction (`govern: [ transaction ]`), so all the reads below see one consistent view and the whole thing commits once at the end.

1. **CheckIdempotencyKey** *(validation / short-circuit)* — reads the optional `Idempotency-Key` header. If that key already created an owner, throws `IdempotentReplayException` → the original owner is replayed with **200** and nothing else runs. Otherwise publishes the key (possibly null) for step 15.

2. **ValidateOwnerFields** *(validation + normalization side-effects)* — binds the request body once and, in this order:
   - requires non-blank `firstName`, `lastName`;
   - **normalizes address**: if `addressLine1` present, normalizes lines and composes `address`; else normalizes flat `address`; if neither present → `address` error;
   - requires non-blank `city`, `telephone`;
   - **normalizes telephone to E.164** (assumes `+61`, drops a leading `0`, strips separators; enforces 8–15 digits and per-country national length for `+61`/`+1`); invalid → `telephone` error;
   - **normalizes email** (via `OwnerEmail`): syntactic check, rejects disposable-domain blocklist (`mailinator/tempmail/guerrillamail.com`), lower-cases it; invalid → `email` error;
   - validates optional `postcode` (must be 4 digits; must fall in the city's region range for Sydney/NSW, Melbourne/VIC, Brisbane/QLD);
   - validates optional `registrationDate` (must not be in the future).
   - Any accumulated errors → `OwnerFieldsValidationException` → **400** with an `errors` array listing each offending field. On success republishes the (mutated/normalized) DTO.

3. **CheckIdentityUnique** *(validation)* — computes `identityKey = SHA-256(normalizedTelephone | lowerEmail | soundex(lastName))` and compares against every non-soft-deleted owner. A whole-key match → `DuplicateIdentityException` → **409**. This is the only hard-duplicate check.

4. **CheckCityCapacity** *(validation)* — counts owners in the same city (case-insensitive); if ≥ 50 → `CityAtCapacityException` → **409**.

5. **BuildOwner** *(side-effect)* — maps the validated DTO onto a new `Owner` entity via `OwnerMapper`.

6. **DefaultRegistrationDate** *(side-effect)* — if no date supplied, uses server's today; then rolls weekends and listed 2026 public holidays forward to the next business day. Mutates the entity's `registrationDate` in place.

7. **CheckDailyLimit** *(validation)* — counts owners already registered on that adjusted business day; if ≥ 100 → `DailyLimitExceededException` → **429**.

8. **AssignMemberId** *(side-effect)* — sets `memberId = <REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>` (region from postcode→city→`UNKNOWN`, two-digit fiscal year, first 8 hex of SHA-256(telephone+lastName), Luhn check digit); on collision with an existing `memberId`, appends `-<n>` (smallest n ≥ 2).

9. **AssignHouseholdId** *(side-effect)* — sets `householdId` derived from normalized lastName + postcode.

10. **AssignHouseholdMemberCount** *(side-effect)* — sets `householdMemberCount` = existing owners sharing that `householdId` **plus one** (this new owner).
